nodes.description: Public entry point Adjudicator.evaluateCFrag that validates a re-encryption CFrag and slashes the staker.
Internal helper computing slashing penalty and investigator reward from staker value and penalty history.
StakingEscrow.slashStaker: reduces staker stake, un-mints tokens and pays the investigator reward.
Staker/worker commitment routine that mints rewards and updates committed periods and locked tokens.
Issuer.mint external minting entry point; performs reward arithmetic and updates period supply.
StakingEscrow.withdraw transfers unlocked tokens back to the staker.
StakingEscrow.deposit pulls tokens from the payer and creates/increases sub-stakes.
Internal locking routine that validates and records locked token amounts per period.
StakingEscrow.bondWorker links a staker to a worker address for commitments.
Dispatcher.upgrade (onlyOwner) verifies and switches the delegatecall target contract.
Dispatcher.rollback (onlyOwner) reverts the delegatecall target to the previous one.
Dispatcher fallback/receive function that delegatecalls the target with msg.data.
Upgradeable.verifyState storage-layout verification executed through delegatecall.
NuCypherToken.approveAndCall approves a spender then calls receiveApproval on it.
Address.sendValue forwards ETH to a recipient via low-level call.
ERC20.transfer moves tokens from msg.sender to a recipient.
ERC20.transferFrom moves tokens using an allowance from msg.sender.
ERC20.approve sets an allowance for a spender.
Issuer.initialize reserves reward tokens and sets initial period supply.
Issuer.donate transfers tokens in and un-mints the amount from supplies.
StakingEscrow.batchDeposit (onlyOwner) bulk-deposits tokens for many stakers.
StakingEscrow.receiveApproval callback used by the token approveAndCall flow.
StakingEscrow.setWorkMeasurement restricted to the WorkLock contract to toggle work measurement.
StakingEscrow.divideStake splits a sub-stake into two parts.
StakingEscrow.prolongStake extends the duration of an active sub-stake.
StakingEscrow.mergeStake merges two sub-stakes with equal last period.
StakingEscrow.setReStake toggles the re-stake flag for the caller.
StakingEscrow.lockReStake locks the re-stake flag until a given period.
StakingEscrow.setWindDown toggles winding down and adjusts sub-stake durations.
StakingEscrow.setSnapshots enables/disables balance snapshot tracking.
Issuer.getCurrentPeriod derives the current period from block.timestamp.
Caller-controlled address used for authorisation, staker identity and reward routing.
Miner-influenced timestamp used to compute the current staking period.
Origin address checked in commitToNextPeriod to force worker calls from EOA.
Low-level delegatecall to the mutable target contract in Dispatcher/Upgradeable.
Low-level call{value:} forwarding ETH to an arbitrary recipient.
ERC20 token transfer out of the contract (withdraw/slash reward).
ERC20 transferFrom pulling tokens from a payer into the contract.
External call from Adjudicator into StakingEscrow.slashStaker with msg.sender as investigator.
External call to an arbitrary TokenRecipient contract in approveAndCall.
Signature recovery used to authenticate CFrag/task/identity signatures.
Mapping of staker addresses to their full StakerInfo struct (value, commitments, sub-stakes).
Mapping counting prior penalties per staker, driving penalty growth.
Mapping marking CFrag hashes already evaluated to prevent double evaluation.
Mapping of period to total locked tokens, used in the minting formula.
Global balance snapshot history array for ERC900 historical queries.
Upgrade status flag (UPGRADE_TRUE/UPGRADE_FALSE) guarding upgrade-only methods.
Current implementation address used by Dispatcher for delegatecalls.
Accumulated token supply for the current period, updated by mint/unMint/initialize.
Policy manager contract address called during commitments and mints.
Adjudicator contract address authorised to call slashStaker.
ERC20 internal balance ledger mapping.
Serialized capsule parameter of evaluateCFrag.
Serialized capsule fragment parameter of evaluateCFrag.
Precomputed EC point data parameter of evaluateCFrag.
Staker address parameter of slashStaker.
Staker token value parameter of calculatePenaltyAndReward.
Penalty amount parameter of slashStaker.
Investigator reward amount parameter of slashStaker.
Investigator address parameter of slashStaker that receives the reward.
Token amount parameter used by withdraw/deposit/donate.
Number of locking periods parameter used by deposit.
Sub-stake index parameter used by divideStake.
Worker address parameter of bondWorker.
New implementation address parameter of Dispatcher.upgrade.
Hash of capsule+cfrag used as the evaluatedCFrags key.
Result flag of the re-encryption validation.
Local period value derived from getCurrentPeriod().
Local next period value used for commitments and lock accounting.
Computed penalty returned by calculatePenaltyAndReward.
Computed reward returned by calculatePenaltyAndReward.
Last committed period of a staker.
Amount of tokens locked in the target period.
Total staker token value read from escrow before slashing.
Worker address recovered from the identity evidence signature.

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the investigator address that receives tokens during the external slashStaker call.
slashStaker is gated by require(msg.sender == address(adjudicator)).
msg.sender is resolved through stakerFromWorker to find the calling staker.
withdraw acts on stakerInfo[msg.sender] and transfers tokens to msg.sender.
msg.sender is used as the payer/owner of transferred tokens in deposit.
lock resolves the staker info from the caller-supplied staker identity.
bondWorker mutates stakerInfo[msg.sender] worker binding.
ERC20 transfer debits _balances[msg.sender].
transferFrom consumes the allowance granted by msg.sender.
approve writes the allowance for msg.sender as owner.
donate pulls tokens from msg.sender via safeTransferFrom.
batchDeposit is protected by onlyOwner and pulls tokens from msg.sender.
setWorkMeasurement requires msg.sender == address(workLock).
setReStake checks lock state and toggles flags for msg.sender.
lockReStake writes lockReStakeUntilPeriod for msg.sender.
setWindDown toggles the wind-down flag of msg.sender.
setSnapshots updates snapshot flags and history for msg.sender.
msg.sender is passed as the _from argument to the receiver callback.
block.timestamp is divided by secondsPerPeriod to derive the current period, making timing miner-influenceable.
commitToNextPeriod relies on the timestamp-derived current period for commitment logic.
slashStake behaviour depends on the timestamp-derived current/next period.
withdraw computes locked amounts using the timestamp-derived current period.
lock computes current and next period from the timestamp to bound lock amounts.
divideStake validates sub-stake periods using the timestamp-derived current period.
prolongStake checks the last period against the timestamp-derived current period.
setSnapshots snapshots are indexed by block number/timestamp-derived state.
commitToNextPeriod requires msg.sender == tx.origin, an anti-contract check based on the origin address.
evaluateCFrag performs an external call to escrow.slashStaker which pays out tokens to msg.sender.
evaluateCFrag recovers multiple signer addresses via ecrecover before proceeding.
slashStaker transfers the investigator reward with token.safeTransfer after mutating state.
approveAndCall first invokes the internal approve flow.
approveAndCall hands control to an arbitrary spender contract via receiveApproval.
sendValue forwards all gas to the recipient via call{value:}, enabling reentrancy.
deposit pulls tokens from the payer via safeTransferFrom before locking.
donate pulls the donated value from msg.sender with safeTransferFrom.
batchDeposit transfers the aggregate staked amount with safeTransferFrom.
withdraw sends tokens to msg.sender with token.safeTransfer before finishing state cleanup.
fallback delegatecalls an arbitrary length of msg.data into the mutable target.
upgrade performs delegatecalls into the new and current targets for state verification.
rollback delegatecalls into previousTarget and target during verification.
verifyState reads storage of another contract through delegateGetData/delegatecall.
upgrade invokes verifyState on the candidate target contract.
rollback invokes verifyState on the previous target contract.
mint computes reward via multiplications and casts before adding to currentPeriodSupply, risking overflow of the uint128 supply.
slashStaker decreases info.value inside the stakerInfo struct.
calculatePenaltyAndReward increments penaltyHistory[_staker].
evaluateCFrag marks evaluatedCFrags[evaluationHash] to block re-evaluation.
commitToNextPeriod adds locked tokens into lockedPerPeriod[nextPeriod].
setSnapshots appends to the global balanceHistory snapshot array.
fallback delegatecalls msg.data to the mutable target address.
upgrade rewrites the target storage slot to the new implementation.
initialize sets currentPeriodSupply as totalSupply - uint128(_reservedReward), a truncating unsigned operation.
commitToNextPeriod calls policyManager.setDefaultFeeDelta on the external contract.
slashStaker is only callable by the adjudicator state variable address.
_capsuleBytes is hashed and deserialized during CFrag validation.
_cFragBytes is validated and hashed inside evaluateCFrag.
_preComputedData supplies attacker-controlled EC points used in the verification equations.
_staker selects the stakerInfo entry to slash.
_stakerValue bounds the computed penalty.
_penalty is subtracted from the staker value.
_reward is transferred to the investigator.
_investigator is the recipient of the token transfer, an attacker-controlled address.
_value is subtracted from info.value during withdrawal.
_value is added to info.value and locked during deposit.
_periods determines the new sub-stake lock duration.
_index selects the sub-stake being divided.
_worker is bound into stakerFromWorker and info.worker.
_target is delegatecalled and written into the target storage slot.
evaluationHash keys evaluatedCFrags to prevent repeat evaluation.
cFragIsCorrect decides whether the slashing branch executes.
currentPeriod is produced by getCurrentPeriod().
nextPeriod is assigned to info.nextCommittedPeriod and lockedPerPeriod.
penalty is the return value of calculatePenaltyAndReward.
reward is the return value of calculatePenaltyAndReward.
lastCommittedPeriod drives downtime recording in commitToNextPeriod.
lockedTokens is added to lockedPerPeriod and emitted in the commitment event.
stakerValue caps the penalty passed to calculatePenaltyAndReward.
worker recovered from the identity evidence is mapped to the slashed staker.

normalization_plan.reason: The capsule byte blob is only consumed by evaluateCFrag's validation logic.
The CFrag blob is strictly an input of evaluateCFrag.
Precomputed EC data exists solely to parameterize CFrag verification.
Staker address parameter scopes the slashing operation.
Staker value is the only input bounding the computed penalty.
Penalty parameter directly drives the stake reduction.
Reward parameter directly drives the investigator token transfer.
Investigator address is the recipient of the slash reward transfer.
Token value parameter determines the withdrawal amount from the staker balance.
Periods parameter determines the deposit sub-stake duration.
Index parameter selects the sub-stake targeted by divideStake.
Worker parameter is the address bound by bondWorker.
Target parameter is the new implementation delegatecalled by upgrade.
Local hash is computed and stored exclusively inside evaluateCFrag.
Local correctness flag is produced and branched on only in evaluateCFrag.
Local current period value originates from getCurrentPeriod().
Local next period value is derived and consumed by the commitment flow.
Local penalty variable is the computed output of calculatePenaltyAndReward.
Local reward variable is the computed output of calculatePenaltyAndReward.
Local last committed period is read and used only in commitToNextPeriod.
Local locked token amount is accumulated only during commitment.
Local staker value is read in slashStaker before penalty computation.
Local recovered worker address is used only in evaluateCFrag to find the staker.
